5. Added the cycle-relabeling lemma to the center-of-\(S_n\) corollary.
6. Replaced an \(A_n\)-specific dependency with `def-index` in the general index-two splitting lemma.

8. Added the sign-from-cycle-structure corollary to the support-reduction lemma.
9. Removed the B-to-B dependency from the \(A_5\) class example and proved the specialization from A-page results.
10. Removed the B-to-B dependency from the false \(A_4\)-simplicity item and proved the \(V_4\) facts inline.
